_comment: Fuentes del catálogo. Cada video necesita licencia verificada antes de entrar. 'zip_member' indica qué archivo sacar si la descarga es un .zip.

videos.title: Big Buck Bunny
videos.description: A giant, gentle rabbit puts up with three bullying rodents until they go one step too far, and he plans his revenge. Blender Foundation's second open movie.

videos.title: Sintel
videos.description: A lonely young woman searches the world for the baby dragon she once rescued and lost. Blender Foundation's third open movie.

videos.title: Tears of Steel
videos.description: In a future Amsterdam, a group of scientists tries to save the world from destructive robots by recreating a single moment from the past. Blender Foundation's live-action and VFX open movie.

videos.title: Elephants Dream
videos.description: Two strange characters explore a capricious and seemingly infinite machine. The world's first open movie, made by the Blender community.
videos.attribution: (c) copyright 2006, Blender Foundation / Netherlands Media Art Institute / www.elephantsdream.org

videos.title: Night of the Living Dead
videos.description: A group of strangers barricade themselves in a farmhouse to survive a night of attacks by the reanimated dead. George A. Romero's landmark horror film.
videos.attribution: Night of the Living Dead (1968), dir. George A. Romero. Public domain (published without a copyright notice). Source: Internet Archive.
videos.notes: El archivo es 480p aunque se llame 720p: la escalera llega hasta 480p.

videos.title: The General
videos.description: When Union spies steal his beloved locomotive, a Southern railroad engineer chases them across enemy lines. Buster Keaton's silent comedy classic.
videos.attribution: The General (1926), dir. Clyde Bruckman and Buster Keaton. Public domain in the United States. Source: Internet Archive.
videos.notes: Verificar que la música agregada en esta copia también sea de dominio público antes de publicar el repo.

videos.title: The Immigrant
videos.description: The Tramp crosses the Atlantic to America, finds love on the voyage and gets into trouble over a single coin in a restaurant. A Charlie Chaplin short.
videos.attribution: The Immigrant (1917), dir. Charlie Chaplin. Public domain in the United States. Source: Internet Archive.
videos.notes: Copia sin pista de audio (verificado con ffprobe): no hay música agregada que revisar.
